candidate.title: The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa`) has been deprecated and will be removed in the future
candidate.text: The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa`) has been deprecated and will be removed in the future. To use the Open Policy Agent authorizer, you can use the `type: custom` authorization.

evidence.locator: L41-L42 (0.46.0 › Major changes, deprecations and removals)
evidence.excerpt:
* The Open Policy Agent authorization (`type: opa`) has been deprecated and will be removed in the future.
  To use the Open Policy Agent authorizer, you can use the `type: custom` authorization.
